title: What a Godly Man Does With Christmas Money (It's Not Just Spending It)
caption:
Bonus check. Cash in a card from Grandma. Extra shifts over break. December puts money in a lot of hands, and most of it is gone by the 27th.

A godly man doesn't let the cart decide. He decides before the money lands.

Give the first part away, not the leftover. Kill some of that card balance. Put a piece away for January rent. Buy one gift that actually costs you something. Then enjoy the rest without guilt, and thank God for it.

"Honor the Lord with your wealth and with the firstfruits of all your produce." Proverbs 3:9

Save this before the money hits.

#faith #godlyman #christianmen #stewardship #christmas
theme: He runs his life — his impulses don't control him.
